title: Tenant-signed Incremental Evidence Packages with Region-aware Delivery
creator: Sofia Patel
description:
Problem: Customers need verifiable, residency-aware bundles of compliance evidence that can be shipped on a schedule or on-demand. Current exports are full snapshots, which are large and slow to generate and move across regions. They also lack cryptographic manifests tied to tenant KMS keys and do not provide incremental deltas for efficient downstream ingestion.

Goal: Build a delivery pipeline that produces cryptographically-signed, tenant-scoped evidence packages (PDF/CSV/JSON) containing only incremental changes since the last successful export, routes packages to region-resident storage endpoints, and exposes a scheduler + audit evidence in the Console. Packages must include a signed manifest with checksums and KMS-backed signatures to support customer verification during audits.
acceptance_criteria: Export pipeline can produce full and incremental (delta) evidence packages per tenant on schedule or on-demand
Each package includes a signed manifest with SHA256 checksums and tenant-scoped key identifier (KMS key ARN)
Console UI allows configuring frequency, time window, destination (region-aware S3/bucket or webhook), and retention mapping
Exports are routed to storage in the tenant's data residency region by default and encrypted at rest with tenant KMS
Delivery uses resumable transfer and verifies checksums post-delivery; failures surfaced on dashboard with retry policy
Audit trail in Console shows package generation time, byte counts, checksums, signer key, and successful delivery confirmations
implementation_notes: Pipeline will extend the existing evidence-collector service to emit change-sets. Use partitioned export jobs keyed by tenant+region. Build a manifest generator that computes checksums and requests a KMS Sign operation per package. For delivery use our existing region-aware S3 routing service with support for signed URLs and optional webhook push for customers who prefer immediate delivery. Keep export generation idempotent: include export_id and incremental cursor (last_event_ts).
rollout_plan:
Phase 1: internal beta with 3 low-traffic tenants; expose on-demand + daily delta exports. Phase 2: enable scheduled weekly/monthly full exports and customer-configurable destinations. Phase 3: broader opt-in and automated retention enforcement. Canary traffic limited to dedicated export workers; monitor CPU/GPU I/O and latency.

Fallbacks: on generator or signing failure, mark package as failed and attempt automatic fallback to a pre-approved emergency archival bucket in tenant's region with limited retention.

qa_checks: Generate full export and incremental delta; verify manifest checksums match file contents
Confirm packages land in tenant residency bucket and are encrypted with tenant KMS key
Simulate network failures and validate resumable delivery and retry behavior
Console: create schedule, preview package, cancel scheduled run, view audit trail entries
Verify webhook delivery requires TLS client cert or destination ownership verification
risks: Operational risk: signing throughput could be a bottleneck for tenants with high-frequency exports. Egress costs if delta calculation is incorrect. UX risk: customers may be confused by full vs delta semantics — need clear Console copy and examples.
compliance_controls: Residency routing: default export destination set to tenant-residency-region
Retention enforcement: exported packages inherit retention policy alignment; expired packages flagged for deletion
Signed manifests: KMS-backed signatures including key version and signer metadata
Encrypted at rest in destination using tenant-managed keys where available
retention_alignment: Export lifecycle mirrors tenant retention windows; administrators can select to keep exports longer for audit purposes. Default behavior: exports older than tenant_retention + export_retention_grace are deleted and an audit entry created.
notes_for_design: Schedule builder should show estimated package size and estimated egress cost
Preview manifest view with checksum validation and signer metadata
Make retention mapping visible at schedule creation with tooltip explaining impact
Provide a toggle for full vs delta exports and show examples of record counts for each
